title: Rules of the VK Cloud Startup Support Program
metaDescription: The VK Cloud Startup Support Program (hereinafter referred to as the “Program”) has been developed by Digital Cloud LLC (OGRN: 1197746546568) (hereinafter referred to as the “Organizer”) and is intended to attract and retain on the VK Cloud Platform companies (legal entities or individual entrepreneurs) that develop digital products and services.
